contract.purpose: Expose SNARC memory visibility to the MAGRA web dashboard.
contract.scope: Provide read-only dashboard endpoints for stats, search, context, inferred patterns, and identity facts.

interfaces.interface-1: handleSnarc(method, rest, body, ctx, query): Promise<ApiResult>

invariants.invariant-2: Search results preserve observed, inferred, and identity provenance labels.
invariants.invariant-3: Missing or corrupt SNARC memory returns bounded API responses.
